description.en: A parallel plate capacitor consists of two large plane parallel conducting plates separated by a small distance. The electric field between the plates is uniform.
description.hi: एक समांतर प्लेट संधारित्र में दो बड़ी समतल समांतर चालक प्लेटें होती हैं जो एक-दूसरे से अल्प दूरी पर होती हैं। प्लेटों के बीच विद्युत क्षेत्र एकसमान होता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Plates -->
  <rect x="100" y="50" width="20" height="200" fill="#3b82f6" opacity="0.8" />
  <rect x="280" y="50" width="20" height="200" fill="#ef4444" opacity="0.8" />

  <!-- Electric Field Lines -->
  <line x1="280" y1="70" x2="120" y2="70" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,70 130,65 130,75" fill="#8b5cf6" />
  <line x1="280" y1="110" x2="120" y2="110" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,110 130,105 130,115" fill="#8b5cf6" />
  <line x1="280" y1="150" x2="120" y2="150" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,150 130,145 130,155" fill="#8b5cf6" />
  <line x1="280" y1="190" x2="120" y2="190" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,190 130,185 130,195" fill="#8b5cf6" />
  <line x1="280" y1="230" x2="120" y2="230" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,230 130,225 130,235" fill="#8b5cf6" />

  <!-- Connections -->
  <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="50" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="300" y1="150" x2="350" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Fringing Fields (Edges) -->
  <path d="M280,50 Q200,20 120,50" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <path d="M280,250 Q200,280 120,250" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
</svg>

title.en: Equipotential Surfaces of a Point Charge

description.en: For a single point charge, the equipotential surfaces are concentric spherical shells with the charge at the center.
description.hi: एकल बिंदु आवेश के लिए, समविभव पृष्ठ आवेश को केंद्र मानकर बने संकेंद्रित गोलीय कोश होते हैं।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 300 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Equipotential Surfaces -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="100" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  
  <!-- Electric Field Lines -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="150" y2="30" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="150,30 145,40 155,40" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="150" y2="270" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="150,270 145,260 155,260" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="30" y2="150" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="30,150 40,145 40,155" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="270" y2="150" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="270,150 260,145 260,155" fill="#3b82f6" />
  
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="65" y2="65" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="65,65 68,78 78,68" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="235" y2="65" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="235,65 222,68 232,78" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="65" y2="235" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="65,235 78,232 68,222" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="235" y2="235" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="235,235 232,222 222,232" fill="#3b82f6" />

  <!-- Central Charge -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="15" fill="#ef4444" />
  <line x1="145" y1="150" x2="155" y2="150" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="150" y1="145" x2="150" y2="155" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
</svg>
